Command.Statement: with set __XLUniqueNames as { [Trips].[Time of day].&[Night] } set __XLDrilledUp as Generate(__XLUniqueNames, { IIF([Trips].[Time of day].currentmember.LEVEL_NUMBER <= 2147483647, [Trips].[Time of day].currentmember, Ancestor([Trips].[Time of day].currentmember, [Trips].[Time of day].currentmember.LEVEL_NUMBER - 2147483647)) } ) member [Measures].__XLPath as Generate( Ascendants([Trips].[Time of day].currentmember), [Trips].[Time of day].currentmember.unique_name, "__XLPSEP") select { [Measures].__XLPath } on 0, __XLDrilledUp on 1 from [DS_SAMPLES] cell properties value
